title: 2026 GCF bus source-data scope and calculation QA

sources.title: 2026 Government greenhouse gas conversion factors for company reporting: Methodology paper

facts.source_fact: Bus factors historically combine DfT Bus Service Operators Grant data with DfT bus activity statistics.
The bus methodology uses vehicle-km, passenger-km and average passenger occupancy information.
From the 2016 update onward, methodology changes were required because underlying dataset scope changed.
BSOG data are now available for commercial services rather than local-authority-supported services.
BSOG data used by the method are available for England outside London rather than for all UK areas.
The methodology derives total fuel consumption from grant amount and the applicable fuel rate.
Total passenger-km are derived from vehicle-km multiplied by average occupancy.
Average fuel consumption is derived per passenger-km.
The bus emission factor combines fuel-related emissions with additional urea-related emissions.
Biofuel use is accounted for in the final bus emission factors.
